cleavage_agent.evidence: The magnetic beads were subjected to enzymatic digestion in 100 μL of 5 ng/μL Trypsin Gold (Promega) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB) for 3.5 h at 37°C and rinsed out with 100 μL of pure water.

collision_energy.evidence: The most intense ions (cycle time 3 s) were selected for MS/MS fragmentation with the HCD collision energy of 30, isolation window at 1.6 m/z and maximum injection time at 22 ms in the centroid mode.
